title: Spotify licence error after collection
summary: Spotify showed a licence-related error. Troubleshooting included confirming connectivity, retrying playback and keeping YouTube Music available as a fallback. Still pending: confirm whether Spotify works consistently after Wilson has slept.

title: Fold 8 wireless charging stability
summary: The phone connects, but charging stability throughout a full drive remains to be confirmed. Position carefully, avoid excess heat and verify charging periodically without distracting from driving.

title: Autosteer bend behaviour to monitor
summary: During brief non-motorway use on factory software, Autosteer appeared to turn into a bend later than Andy would normally and made alternating left-right corrections. This is a direct owner observation, not a diagnosed fault. Road markings, bend geometry and other conditions may affect behaviour; take over immediately whenever the path feels uncomfortable or uncertain.
